title: ConserveEdit: Source-Anchored Transactions for Drift-Bounded Iterative Image Editing
abstract: arXiv:2611.22724v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Instruction-driven image editors produce convincing local edits in one pass, but inside an iterative refinement loop every accepted output becomes the next input, so unintended changes outside the requested region accumulate. We present ConserveEdit, an editor-agnostic controller that treats each refinement step as a transaction against a contract compiled once from the source image. The contract separates what may change (the authorized region of each target, with a bounded halo for shadows and reflections) from what must survive (protected content with explicit tolerances). Candidates from a frozen editor are composed through a source-anchored mask and committed only if target progress, drift on protected content, and image quality pass as separate tests; otherwise the step is rolled back and repaired. translated_title: ConserveEdit：基于源图像锚定事务的漂移有界迭代图像编辑
translated_abstract: 指令驱动的图像编辑器能够在一次处理中产生令人信服的局部编辑，但在迭代细化循环中，每个被接受的输出都会成为下一个输入，导致请求区域之外的意外变化不断累积。我们提出ConserveEdit，这是一个与编辑器无关的控制器，它将每个细化步骤视为针对一份从源图像一次性编译所得契约的事务。该契约将允许改变的内容（每个目标的授权区域，并为阴影和反射保留有限的边缘晕圈）与必须保留的内容（具有明确容差的受保护内容）分离开来。来自冻结编辑器的候选结果通过源锚定掩码进行合成，只有当目标进展、受保护内容上的漂移和图像质量分别通过独立测试时才会被提交；否则该步骤将被回滚并修复。对于任何编辑器，这都能保证授权区域之外的每个像素保持位级精确一致，并将漂移限制在与迭代次数无关的范围内。
tldr: ConserveEdit提出了一种与编辑器无关的事务式控制器，通过从源图像编译的契约将授权区域与受保护内容分离，确保迭代图像编辑中授权区域外的像素保持位级精确不变，且漂移与迭代次数无关。
en_tdlr: ConserveEdit introduces an editor-agnostic transaction-based controller that separates authorized regions from protected content via a contract compiled once from the source image, guaranteeing bit-exact pixels outside the authorized region and iteration-count-independent drift bounds in iterative image editing.
